about_the_game:
Game Overview

Sin Ante fuses management simulation with life-or-death Texas Hold’em in a world where performance is salvation and your soul is the stake.

By day, you assign damned souls to labor and squeeze every last KPI from them.

By night, you sit at Hell’s poker table, wagering souls against devils in duels of chance, power, and repentance.

Crush desire. Outplay demons. Defeat yourself—until the final bullet drops.

♠️ About the Game

— When KPIs become chips, your soul is the only currency.

In the Tenth Circle of Hell—“False Virtue”, you are no savior.

You are a manager of sinners, a slave to performance, and Hell’s most reckless gambler.

Daylight is for labor. Command the condemned. Extract productivity. Silence rebellion.

Nightfall is for the table—1 v 1 no-limit Texas Hold’em duels against other infernal executives.

Lose, and your soul faces the revolver.

Win, and you ascend deeper—into greater power, and greater sin.

🎲 Gameplay Highlights

☀️ Day: Manage Your Sin Empire

  • Assign souls to work, balance efficiency, and suppress unrest.

  • Each soul’s attributes (S / I / N) affect their output.

  • Overwork leads to strikes, breakdowns, or story events.

  • KPI is the only currency you can bring to the table.

🌙 Night: Wager Your Soul

  • Each night demands a 1 v 1 no-limit Hold’em match.

  • Set your own KPI stakes—risk and reward are both in your hands.

  • Lose, and the Revolver Ritual begins: one bullet, one soul, permanent death.

  • Every opponent has unique voice-acted personalities and playstyles, turning each match into psychological warfare in Hell.

🔫 Six-Round Poker × Revolver Ritual

  • Each duel spans six rounds; at the end of every round, an execution follows.

  • Ties trigger Overtime Rounds—higher risk, double reward.

  • When all resources run dry, invoke Last Chance:

    borrow a hundred chips, and bet your own life.

💼 KPI Is Life

In this infernal KPI war, can you balance power, faith, and guilt—

or will you become just another entry in Hell’s quarterly report?

“In this place, even gods care only for numbers.

And you — you’re just one more data point under review.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: Sin Ante fuses management and no-limit Hold’em. By day, assign damned souls, squeeze KPIs, quell unrest. By night, wager performance and souls in 1v1 duels. Six-round matches, Revolver Ritual, and a Last Chance loan test whether numbers save you—or erase you.
